name: OpenComputer
description: Deploys TypeScript agents onto real Linux machines with durable sessions and tool support, hosted or self-run. Positioned as a Firebase-style backend for agents.

skills.name: Agent Deployment
skills.description: Deploys a TypeScript agent onto a real Linux machine with its filesystem and processes managed by the platform.

skills.name: Durable Sessions
skills.description: Keeps agent sessions alive across restarts and long-running tasks so state survives beyond a single request.

skills.name: Tool Runtime
skills.description: Runs agent tool calls inside the hosted machine, giving agents shell and filesystem access within a sandbox.
